channel.title: API on Sujith Quintelier
channel.description: Recent content in API on Sujith Quintelier

item.title: github: Copilot code review: API support and new default effort level
item.description:
GitHub Copilot code review can now be requested through both the REST and GraphQL APIs, and each request can specify an effort level. The default effort level has changed to Balanced.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: New fields for SecurityAdvisory GraphQL API
item.description:
GitHub added five new fields to the SecurityAdvisory GraphQL object, allowing more of the GitHub Advisory Database to be read directly through GraphQL instead of using the REST API. The changelog notes one of the new fields as cveId.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Changes to query results in the GitHub Actions API and UI
item.description:
GitHub Actions workflow run queries in the API and UI now return a less precise but more accurate total count for search results across filters like workflow, event, status, and branch.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: SCIM user responses now include a profileUrl attribute
item.description:
GitHub SCIM user responses now include the RFC 7643 standard profileUrl attribute. It returns the absolute URL of the GitHub account linked to the external identity.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: New API endpoint provides privacy-safe star history data
item.description:
GitHub added a new REST API endpoint for repository star history that lets users track star growth over time without exposing individual stargazer identities. This follows earlier restrictions on stargazer listing endpoints to admins and collaborators.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: GitHub Classroom deprecated
item.description:
GitHub Classroom was deprecated on August 28, 2026 and replaced by selected partner solutions. The Classroom website, APIs, and related services have been decommissioned.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Copilot usage metrics API adds agent app activity
item.description:
The Copilot usage metrics API now includes activity from agent apps used in GitHub workflows. This extends usage reporting to agents from partners such as Claude and Codex.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: GitHub Models is now retired
item.description:
GitHub Models was retired on July 30, 2026. The playground, model catalog, inference API, and bring-your-own-key (BYOK) access are no longer available to customers.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: GitHub Copilot app now available in the usage metrics API
item.description:
The GitHub Copilot usage metrics API now includes GitHub Copilot app usage in enterprise and organization 1-day and 28-day reports. This adds admin visibility into Copilot app usage data.

  • Source: GitHub
